_comment: Prompt variants for the participants e-mail (docs/design/speaker-contacts.md §7). Same call shape as the card's title/prose: one fresh user turn, no system turn, {notes} = the journal compacted to reader.notes_chars. 'clean': 'prose' = ReaderLane.cleanProse (timestamps checked, bullets/headings dropped); otherwise timestamps repaired only. 'prose' is the shipped card's prose prompt, re-run on the same journal as the baseline. 'typed' = 'hybrid' with the note types spelled out and the decide/propose rule, added after the first E2B judging showed 'hybrid' calling proposals decisions.

zh.prompt:
以下是一場會議的筆記：

{notes}

會議標題：{title}
日期：{date}

根據這些筆記，寫一封寄給與會者的電子郵件內文，完全依照下面的格式，不要加其他標題：

各位好：
（一到兩句開場，說明這是哪一場會議）

【摘要】
（一段話）

【決議事項】
- （每項一行，句尾附時間）

【待辦與負責人】
- （每項一行，寫出負責人，句尾附時間）

【保留與未決】
- （每項一行，句尾附時間）

只寫筆記裡有的內容；筆記裡還在提議的事不要寫成決議；某一節沒有內容就寫「- 無」。時間格式例如 [1:23]。

en.prompt:
Here are the notes of a meeting:

{notes}

Title: {title}
Date: {date}

From these notes, write the body of an e-mail in English to the participants, exactly in the format below, with no other headings:

Hi all,
(one or two sentences saying which meeting this is)

Summary
(one paragraph)

Decisions
- (one item per line, ending with its time)

Action items and owners
- (one item per line, with the owner, ending with its time)

Open issues
- (one item per line, ending with its time)

Only write what is in the notes; do not turn a proposal into a decision; write "- None" under a heading with nothing in it. Times look like [1:23].
